name: manual_37ee7b
claim: Never thread urlopen()-only kwargs (e.g. assert_same_host) into pool_kwargs/conn_kw -- they silently propagate to Connection.__init__(**kwargs) and crash with TypeError, but only on a REAL connection attempt, never a mocked one

decisions.notes: assert_same_host is a urllib3 HTTPConnectionPool.urlopen() parameter, not a pool- or connection-constructor kwarg. It was carried in ssrf_pinned_adapter.py's pool_kwargs since the adapter's first commit, silently latent because every prior test mocked either ssrf_request itself or the pool-level urlopen -- never real connection construction. Only a live end-to-end sanity check (ssrf_request('GET','https://api.github.com/zen')) surfaced 'HTTPSConnection.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument assert_same_host'. General lesson: when wiring extra kwargs through requests/urllib3's adapter->pool->connection chain, verify EVERY hop with at least one real (unmocked) network call before trusting a fully-mocked test suite is sufficient -- mocking at the wrong layer hides exactly this class of bug.
